# artisanvirt_nodes (Data Source)

Lists hypervisor nodes, optionally filtered by state or cluster. Use `state = "discovered"` to find hosts that enrolled and wait for approval.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_nodes" "ready" {
  state = "ready"
}

output "ready_nodes" {
  value = data.artisanvirt_nodes.ready.nodes[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `cluster_id` (String) Only members of this cluster.
- `state` (String) Only nodes in this state.
